title: Equality of Successive Prefixes
statement: For any two finite binary strings $u$ and $v$ and any $j\in\mathbb{N}$, their prefixes of length $j+1$ agree if and only if their prefixes of length $j$ agree and the optional entries at index $j$ agree.
replaced: For all binary strings $u, v$ and every index $j$, the length-$(j+1)$ prefixes of $u$ and $v$ agree if and only if their length-$j$ prefixes agree and their optional bits at index $j$ agree, a missing bit counting as different from any present bit.
